title: A thoughtful Ganesh Chaturthi invitation
excerpt: Make your welcome personal and your visiting details clear, with editable wording for a home or community celebration.

sections.heading: Write for the gathering you are hosting
paragraphs: A Ganesh Chaturthi invitation should reflect the celebration in your home or community. Begin with the hosts’ names and a warm welcome. Add devotional wording or imagery only if you want it, and choose phrases that fit your own practice rather than treating a template as a requirement.

You can write the invitation in Marathi, Hindi, English or another language that feels comfortable for your guests. Keep the date and visiting time explicit. Do not rely on the festival name alone to tell people when your particular gathering takes place.
sections.quote: आमच्या घरी गणेशोत्सवाच्या आनंदात सहभागी व्हा. आपल्या भेटीने हा दिवस आणखी खास होईल.

sections.heading: Separate visiting hours from scheduled moments
paragraphs: If guests can visit over a period of time, state that window clearly. If you want everyone present for an aarti, prayer or meal, give each scheduled moment its own time. Include only the activities you are actually arranging; a shorter accurate invitation is better than an elaborate programme that does not apply.

Dates and observances can depend on the plans followed by your household or organisers. Confirm your event details before sharing rather than copying a date from a previous invitation. For a community venue, include the hall, entrance and any useful access instructions.
list: Add the exact date, local time and timezone for your gathering.
Clarify whether visiting is flexible or everyone should arrive together.
Check the full address and Google Maps location.
Mention food or other arrangements only when they are confirmed.

sections.heading: Keep the invitation welcoming and editable
paragraphs: An English message could be: ‘Please join our family for our Ganesh Chaturthi gathering. We look forward to welcoming you and sharing this time together.’ You can add a chosen blessing, replace the closing or use your own family wording throughout.

In Invitly, start with Other gathering, then set your cover text and schedule titles to match the occasion. Preview the invitation on a phone and check that the visiting time and directions are easy to find. Share the finished link with the people you intend to welcome, and let them know directly if your plans change.
